NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_MORNING_SUN.flavor: [i]“If one must always leave early and return late, there is no time left to admire the sun.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_DOOR_GRASS.flavor: [i]“They say I am like a weed. I want to see what grass looks like.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_MEMORIAL_STONES.flavor: [i]“I should have climbed that tower, but I fell at its foot.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_HOME_DUST.flavor: [i]“What did these two words originally mean? Which one means ‘home’?”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_NEW_BRANCH.flavor: [i]“You are only telling me now that I have a child?”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_LEAD_BREASTPLATE.flavor: [i]“After you knock, if someone inside opens the door, tell them I am gone.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_STORED_INSTRUMENTS.flav: [i]“Forget it. Their ancestors are watching over them; surely nothing too terrible will happen.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_KNOT_THREAD.flavor: [i]“Once you pull it across, it will be a new year. Shame I will not live to see it.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_CROWN_OF_CHIEFTAIN.flav: [i]“I lived through your grandfather's entire life. Now it is your turn. Take good care of your people.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_EMPTY_REVERIE.flavor: [i]“With this happening to me, I do not know what they will have to eat. Ah...”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_MERCENARY.f: [i]“Some earn a living for themselves, and some earn one for their families.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_CIVIL_WAR.f: [i]“Some say it is finally over, but others say it will never end.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_WALL.flavor: [i]“Remember how these stones are stacked. While they deal with the stones, you can escape.”[/i]
[i]“Once the lords of the Royal Court finish their spell, run along the old road. The outsiders will not find you.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_PILLAGE.fla: [i]“What else can we do? Rob them. Rob the sheep, rob the cats. They rob us too.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_INVASION.fl: [i]“The Sarkaz want to ‘conquer.’ What does ‘conquer’ mean? Take what you want, never return it, and never leave.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_MARCH.flavo: [i]“Come on, move faster. The road is so long, and death is still waiting for us.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_OATHBREAK.f: [i]“I already told the people in the city that the gates would open. Come in. Come kill us.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_REST.flavor: [i]“Get some rest while you can. Once the cannons start, you will have plenty to do.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_SLEEP.flavo: [i]“After working all my life, I can finally sleep soundly. Make all the noise you want; I will not wake up.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_CATASTROPHE: [i]“What must come always comes. Those in charge thought there was no need to move the city.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_FURNACE.fla: [i]“You hardly ever freeze. That is the best thing about staying in the city.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_OUTBLOOD.fl: [i]“You do not need to remember what anyone's ears look like. They can always tell you are Sarkaz.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_FLAMES.flav: [i]“Ha, that will not happen. There is nothing here that can catch fire.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_LOST.flavor: [i]“Out with the old, in with the new! Next time, we can rebuild it differently.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_CITY_DRIVIN: [i]“Remember: no faster than five kilometers per hour, or it will take another ten years to repair.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_TEMPER_BLAD: [i]“Remember what you put on the weapon, or you will end up hurting yourself with it.”[/i]
[i]“If I kill you, I get a full meal. Is that so hard to understand?”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_CONSUME.fla: [i]“At first, we still farmed. Everyone lived in the support levels, and the sunlight was left to the crops.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_RECLAIM.fla: [i]“Later, Her Highness got the hydroponics working. Only then did we win some space back from the crops.”[/i]
NYMPH_CARD_NYMPH_INSPIRATION_RISE_AND_FA: [i]“I plan to leave the city and find work elsewhere.”[/i]
